recipes.name: ui-flat-shape
recipes.parent: M_UI_Shape_Rectangle (Epic's UI shape material; check the exact name in the project)
recipes.use: Flat UI fill: rectangle with optional border and gradient, with interaction-state looks
steps: Create a material instance of the UI shape parent
Switch gradient on for fill and/or stroke and set the colors with the boolean toggles
Set the state properties for hover, focus, press, disabled if the widget needs them
Assign a physical material (typically Wood) to avoid transparent edges
Drag the instance into the widget blueprint; combine several instances for a full design
